runs.question: How long do CFO Act agencies have to publish an AI strategy under the OMB AI memos?

answer.text:
The memos give two different deadlines, so the answer depends on which one applies.

- **OMB M-25-21 (April 2025): 180 days.** Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications. The strategy must be made public. Agencies must use the AI Strategies template, to be provided by 0MB, and make their AI Strategies publicly available.

- **OMB M-24-10 (March 2024): 365 days.** Within 365 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop and release publicly on the agency's website a strategy for identifying and removing barriers to the responsible use of AI and achieving enterprise-wide improvements in AI maturity. The consolidated action table in the same memo lists the same 365-day deadline for this strategy.

The two memos conflict. The passages do not say whether M-25-21 replaces the 365-day requirement in M-24-10, so I can't say which deadline governs today. The more recent memo sets 180 days, but confirming that it supersedes the earlier one would require text from the memos that I did not retrieve. Check the M-25-21 text on its relationship to M-24-10 before relying on either deadline.
